primitive: Capability-scoped host imports for sandbox components, so a host can bind checked FS, Net, or Exec rights to a plugin world without ambient authority.
evidence: `/home/nate/Projects/Github/jet/scripts/agent/jet-env jet build /home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/prim-capabilities/fs_guest_pkg/run.jet --target=sandbox` returns E1258: `A sandbox can't use any effect`; the source calls `fs.read`. `/home/nate/Projects/Github/jet/scripts/agent/jet-env jet build /home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/prim-capabilities/net_guest_pkg/run.jet --target=sandbox` returns E3304: `core.net` is not available for target `sandbox`. The working plugin WIT has zero imports.
workaround: Keep all FS, Net, and Exec in the trusted host and pass scalar data to the guest, or use trusted native code without the sandbox boundary.

primitive: Resource-scoped authority enforcement for ordinary `core.files` operations, such as `read(path, authority)` with a no-follow root boundary.
evidence: `/home/nate/Projects/Github/jet/scripts/agent/jet-env jet run /home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/prim-capabilities/scoped_fs_pkg/run.jet --allow-fs` with `authority.holds.allow: [IO, Mem.Alloc, "FS.Read:/home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/prim-capabilities/inputs"]` returns E1803: `required_effects=FS, IO, Mem.Alloc; granted_effects=FS.Read:/home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/prim-capabilities/inputs, IO, Mem.Alloc; undecided_effects=FS`. Replacing the manifest with broad `[FS, IO, Mem.Alloc]` lets the same path-only `fs.read` program print both `inside=inside-capability` and `outside=outside-capability`.
workaround: Use package-wide FS and manually validate paths; the shipped no-follow root boundary is only on `plugin.load` for WASM artifacts.

primitive: A versioned typed plugin ABI for records, lists, resources, callbacks, and asynchronous values, in addition to homogeneous scalar exports.
evidence: `/home/nate/Projects/Github/jet/scripts/agent/jet-env jet build /home/nate/.cache/jet-luna/dx3/prim-capabilities/rich_guest_pkg/run.jet --target=sandbox` returns E1260: `pub fn sum` is not one homogeneous `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, or `Text` shape.
